messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: P1 - us-west-2 network + ALB 5xx surge affecting customer traffic (~10%+ error rate). Trigger: ALB target timeouts and NATGW conn-wait metric spike. Pager: https://pagerduty.example/INC-60712
oncall-jordan: Acknowledged. I'm pulling up dashboards and recent deploys. Who's on network?
sre-ash: Joining. ALB 5xx for api and ingestion lanes up at ~11:12 UTC. Startup: 11:10 UTC from synthetic probes.
net-lee: I'm looking at VPC flow logs & NATGW metrics. natgw-usw2b shows ConnectionWaitTime high and a ConnectionAttempt backlog. Several subnets show asymmetric egress to natgw-usw2b/natgw-usw2c.
infra-sam: Host-side: some EC2s in usw2b reporting elevated softirq and EBS i/o wait, not universal but correlates with time window.
support-chet: Support queue: ~25 customer tickets flagged high; MediaStream and LiveIngest reporting webhooks failing. Logging timeline for customers.
oncall-jordan: @sre-ash lead service side remediation, @net-lee handle network plane. I'll coordinate external comms with @prod-emma and @support-chet.
sre-ash: Running quick health checks:
```
aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:tg:us-west-2:123456:tg/api-prod
# many targets HEALTH:unhealthy (connection-timeout)
```
net-lee: Packet-sample shows many TCPs stuck at SYN_SENT -> SYN_RECV; NATGW conn-tracking entries ramped. natgw metrics: ConnectionCount=~250k, ConnectionWaitTime spikes.
infra-sam: Could be NATGW conntrack saturation causing retries and higher host CPU for network stacks; EBS ops may suffer due to CPU/network stalls.
prod-emma: What's the scope? Estimating traffic affected and endpoints so we can draft customer notice.
oncall-jordan: Rough: 10-15% failure for /v1/generate and webhook ingestion endpoints in us-west-2; embeddings less impacted. Some spillover causing elevated p95 elsewhere.
net-lee: Mitigation plan: shift egress for affected private subnets to natgw-usw2a (healthy) via route table swap, staged to avoid full churn. Also consider ALB zone draining and prefer healthy AZs by adjusting ALB routing weight (target group rebal). Need emergency approval for route edits.
prod-emma: Approve emergency route edits and a weighted Route53 traffic shift to us-west-1 for critical endpoints. Notify security if we touch cross-account NATs.
support-chet: Drafting customer status v1. Will include recommended retries/backoff and note that engineers are applying mitigations.
sre-ash: Scaling idea: add additional targets in healthy AZs and reduce ALB idle timeout temporarily to free stuck connections.
deploy-bot: Automated action: Added 4 instances to api-prod-target-group in us-west-2a per SRE scale-policy.
net-lee: Executing staged route change: subnet-10a (abc) 0.0.0.0/0 from natgw-usw2b -> natgw-usw2a. Performing one subnet at a time, 60s monitoring between moves. First subnet in 45s.
oncall-jordan: Go for it. Post status after each subnet swap.
net-lee: subnet-10a switched -> natgw-usw2a. Monitoring metrics.
sre-ash: ALB 5xx dropped from 11.8% -> 6.1% after first switch. ConnectionWaitTime on natgw-usw2a showing healthy capture.
support-chet: Sent customer notice v1: "We are investigating higher error rates for ingestion and webhooks in us-west-2. Engineers are performing mitigations; no evidence of data loss. Next update in 30 minutes."
infra-sam: EBS iowait on some nodes reduced after subnet egress switch. Host metrics align with network congestion symptoms.
net-lee: Proceeding with remaining subnets (3 left). Keeping one subnet on original natgw to allow rollback if we see regression.
sre-ash: While net moves proceed, enabling ALB connection draining on unhealthy instances and setting slow-start for new targets. Also setting ALB idle_timeout to 18s to cycle stuck connections faster.
deploy-bot: ALB idle_timeout adjusted to 18s on api-prod listeners (change applied).
oncall-jordan: Update: Overall 5xx now ~3-4% across the cluster. Keeping P1 until we see 30m stable post-final swap.
pm-nina: Logging customer impact: MediaStream saw ~14% failures during peak window; BigCorp ingestion had ~19% spike for ~12 minutes. Note SLA threshold at 15% sustained over 1h for credit.
net-lee: Final two subnets switched; full egress moved off natgw-usw2b. Currently monitoring for 30m to confirm stability.
sre-ash: Running synthetic validations: endpoint /v1/generate and ingestion probes now green. KV cache warmups look okay. No cache stampede observed.
oncall-jordan: Team, next steps:
- Keep this channel active until 30m stable window complete.
- Save all command outputs and logs into the incident doc.
- @net-lee paste exact route table diffs and timestamps into the postmortem doc.
- @infra-sam collate EC2/EBS host metrics.
- @sre-ash own postmortem.
support-chet: Customer update v2 sent: "Services stabilizing; targeted network remediation applied; monitoring continues." :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Status=mitigated; monitoring active. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-60712
oncall-jordan: Preparing handoff to daytime SRE in 18m. If no regression, will close active P1 and assign postmortem owner.
pm-nina: Assigning postmortem owner: @sre-ash. Primary hypothesis: natgw conntrack saturation in usw2b + route reconvergence causing asymmetric egress and higher host-level I/O latency, compounded by ALB connection distribution. Include timeline, metrics and customer impact in postmortem.
sre-ash: Acknowledged. Will prepare timeline, metric dashboards, config diffs, and suggested mitigations (increase natgw capacity or move to NAT instances, add automated egress balancing, and revisit ALB routing weights). Thanks team. :heart:
